metadata.title: Secure Endpoint

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining and asserting institutional trust in endpoint devices as acceptable execution environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint devices, operating systems, firmware, hardware roots of trust, and endpoint security services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern defining the conditions and constraints under which endpoints are trusted as execution environments.

props.name: dependency-class
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint is a Tier-1 institutional trust dependency underpinning identity assurance, network access, and data protection.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint inherits foundational trust invariants from Endpoint Core.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint relies on Secure Identity for principal-to-device binding and authentication context.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint relies on Secure Network to enforce access decisions using endpoint identity and posture.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint requires TPM-backed cryptographic keys managed by the institutional Key Management Platform.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint requires PKI-issued device certificates to establish and validate endpoint identity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint aligns with Zero Trust principles, treating endpoints as conditional trust entities.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Endpoint aligns with foundational endpoint, identity, and platform integrity guidance.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of unmanaged or compromised devices to gain unauthorized access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise or reuse of endpoint credentials or private keys.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence via firmware or boot-chain compromise.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Hardware-backed identity binding prevents endpoint spoofing.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Measured and secure boot preserve endpoint integrity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Endpoint observability and telemetry support accountability.

metadata.remarks: Secure Endpoint is the composite governance pattern asserting which endpoint devices the institution is willing to trust as execution environments. It integrates identity, configuration, posture, runtime protection, and lifecycle governance, while deliberately excluding application logic and data governance. Detailed enforcement is defined by constituent endpoint patterns and SSPPs.
